RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Raising the panel’s gender without concrete evidence of discriminatory conduct will likely damage your professional reputation and burn bridges within the institution. 

An all-female panel alone is not proof of bias. For a department head position, selection committees frequently prioritize formal management training and broad operational leadership over higher academic credentials like a PhD. Furthermore, a two-week delay in providing written feedback is standard administrative bureaucracy in hospital HR workflows rather than a sign of evasion.

Instead of alleging bias, send a polite follow-up requesting your feedback. Frame it constructively around identifying specific leadership competencies you can develop for future executive roles.
